prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1370; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle presented with side-impact damage consistent with the described intersection collision, centered on the driver-side rear quarter panel and adjacent door skin. Intrusion is limited and the crush pattern follows the reported direction of force. Repair plan calls for panel replacement, refinishing, and alignment checks on the rear door hinge area. Labor hours appear slightly elevated for the extent of the damage and should be reviewed against the standard time guide before approval. Shop invoices show no duplicated charges. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record.
